name: aged_receivables
description: Aged receivables per tenant: 0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+ day buckets (built-in AgedReceivables report).
answer_hint: Defaults: current tenants only, prospects NOT included, no minimum balance or days-late threshold (so totals exceed the delinquency recipe). For the delinquency view use the delinquency recipe.

property.description: Property name/nickname/ID, comma-separated for several; empty = all

balance_at_least.description: only accounts with a balance >= this amount; empty = all balances

headline: Total receivable {sum$:Total} across {count} accounts as of {as_of}: 0-30 days {sum$:0_30}, 31-60 {sum$:31_60}, 61-90 {sum$:61_90}, over 90 {sum$:over_90}.
